items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: your first one was "Big Chief Moore's Pow Wow Jazz Band," with Ed Polger on clarinet, Dick Wellstood on piano, Gene Ramey bass and Jack Williams on drums

ctx.x: Well, when you finally put out these recordings, your first one was "Big Chief Moore's Pow Wow Jazz Band," with Ed Polger on clarinet, Dick Wellstood on piano, Gene Ramey bass and Jack Williams on drums and that was recorded in 1973 and you've got some old favorites on there, of course, like "Wabash Blues," "St. Louis Blues," "Some Day You'll be Sorry."
